patterns: What graduate programs does EMU offer?
Can you list the master's degrees?
Are there any doctoral programs?
Which graduate degrees are available?
What can I study at the graduate level?
responses: EMU offers graduate programs in fields like Nursing, Business Administration (MBA), Counseling, Peacebuilding, Education, and Seminary studies.
We also offer a Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) and other specialized certificates.
Visit emu.edu/graduate for a full list of available programs.

patterns: How do I apply to a graduate program?
What's the application process?
Where do I submit my graduate application?
Is there a fee to apply for grad school?
Can I apply online?
responses: You can apply online via the EMU website under the Graduate Admissions section.
Each program may have slightly different requirements, so be sure to check the specific program page.
There is usually a non-refundable application fee unless waived during promotions.

patterns: What are the admission requirements?
Do I need a certain GPA?
Is the GRE required?
What documents do I need to submit?
Are there prerequisite courses?
responses: Requirements vary by program, but generally include transcripts, letters of recommendation, a personal statement, and a resume.
Some programs may require interviews or prior coursework. Most do not require GRE scores.
Check your program’s page for full details.

patterns: Can I study online?
Are there remote grad programs?
Do you offer hybrid or online courses?
Is the MBA program online?
Can I complete my degree remotely?
responses: Yes, several of EMU's graduate programs are available fully online or in hybrid formats.
The MBA, DNP, and some education programs offer flexible learning options to fit your schedule.
Visit the specific program page to see available delivery formats.

patterns: Is there financial aid for grad students?
Can I get a scholarship?
Do you offer assistantships or fellowships?
What are the tuition costs?
How do I pay for graduate school?
responses: Yes, graduate students can apply for financial aid, scholarships, and employer tuition reimbursement.
Each program may have scholarships or assistantships available—check with the program coordinator.
You can also complete the FAFSA to determine eligibility for federal loans.

patterns: Can international students apply?
Do I need a visa to study at EMU?
Are grad programs open to international applicants?
What are the requirements for international students?
responses: Yes, EMU welcomes international graduate students.
You’ll need to provide TOEFL/IELTS scores, transcripts, and apply for a student visa (F-1).
Reach out to EMU’s international admissions office for personalized support.

patterns: How long does a graduate program take?
What’s the length of the MBA?
Can I finish my degree in one year?
Is the program full-time or part-time?
How many credits do I need?
responses: Program lengths vary—most master’s programs take 1.5 to 2 years full-time, but part-time options are available.
Some certificates or fast-track programs can be completed in under a year.
Credit requirements and pacing differ by program—check your program’s page for specifics.

patterns: What’s student life like for grad students?
Are there events for grad students?
Do grad students live on campus?
Can I use campus facilities as a grad student?
Are there networking opportunities?
responses: Graduate students have access to all campus resources including the library, fitness center, and career services.
There are regular networking events, professional development workshops, and opportunities to engage with the community.
Some housing options may be available for graduate students, or you can live off-campus.

patterns: How do I contact the graduate office?
Who do I talk to for questions about grad school?
Is there a number I can call about grad admissions?
Can I schedule a meeting with a grad advisor?
responses: You can contact the EMU Graduate Admissions Office via email at gradadmissions@emu.edu or call (540) 432-xxxxx.
Each program also has a dedicated coordinator—check the program webpage for direct contact info.
They’re happy to schedule a virtual or in-person meeting to answer your questions.
